# Ship to Live — 夏裕科技股份有限公司 — by Yufan Chen

> Ship to Live is the trading name of two companies founded by Yufan Chen — QY LLC in San Diego, California (US engagements) and 夏裕科技股份有限公司 in Taipei, Taiwan (Taiwan engagements, unified business number 90173045). It is the studio of Yufan Chen — a software engineer and engineering lead with twenty-five years of experience across three-person startups and century-old institutions, working from two bases: San Diego, California and Taipei, Taiwan. Yufan builds AI agents and automations that reach production — wired into the database, back office, and workflow a business already runs — and does SEO, AEO and GEO so Google and AI engines name that business. Bilingual in English and Traditional Chinese (中文), serving clients across the United States and Taiwan. Contact by email or through the contact form; phone is not published. Website: https://shiptolive.com/ · 中文版: https://shiptolive.com/zh/

## What I do

- **AI agents & assistants** — an assistant that answers from your own documents, policies, and data, and can act on them: look up the record, draft the reply, file the result. Built on your stack, with your permissions, not a rented black box. Includes document and knowledge agents, support and intake agents, back-office automation, and internal tools with AI inside.
- **AI search optimization — SEO, AEO & GEO** — Search Engine Optimization to rank on Google; Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) so your content wins featured snippets and Google AI Overviews; and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) so AI engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini understand, trust, cite, and recommend your business. Delivered as an AI visibility audit, structured data and an llms.txt layer, technical SEO, trust signals, and local/bilingual coverage.
- **Systems & integrations** — databases, admin back ends, APIs, deployment, and the migrations nobody wants to run. The layer that decides whether an AI pilot becomes something a team opens on Monday morning.
- **Mobile apps & websites** — iOS, Android, and Mac from one codebase (Flutter, React Native); fast bilingual sites that load and rank, with AI built in where it earns its place.

## How an AI project runs

1. **Find the bottleneck** — a conversation, not a questionnaire. Free, about an hour.
2. **Pilot one workflow** — two weeks, fixed price, running on your real data. At the end you have something usable, or a clear answer that AI is not the right tool for that workflow.
3. **Wire it in** — permissions, logging, error handling, deployment, handover documentation.

Ways to start: an **AI Visibility Check** (3 days), an **Agent Pilot** (2 weeks), or a **fractional builder** engagement (monthly). Fixed price, quoted in one email.

## Data handling

The scope of what an agent can read and what it is allowed to do is defined up front, every action it takes is logged, and a person stays in the loop anywhere a mistake would be expensive. Where an industry has rules about where data can sit, that constraint is designed for from day one rather than retrofitted.

## 中文摘要

夏裕科技股份有限公司（統一編號 90173045，品牌名 Ship to Live）是 Yufan Chen 創立的軟體工程公司，
在美國加州聖地牙哥與台灣台北兩地營運。主要提供三件事：

1. **AI 代理與自動化** — 把 AI 代理接進企業既有的資料庫、後台與工作流程，能依你的文件與規章回答，
   並實際完成動作（查紀錄、擬回覆、歸檔）；權限由你界定、每個動作留下日誌。
2. **AI 搜尋最佳化（SEO / AEO / GEO）** — 讓企業在 Google 搜尋結果、Google AI 概覽與精選摘要，
   以及 ChatGPT、Perplexity、Gemini 的生成式回答中被找到與被引用。做法包含結構化資料、
   llms.txt 內容層、技術 SEO 與信任訊號。
3. **系統、後端、App 與網站** — 資料庫、管理後台、API、部署與資料搬遷；以及 iOS / Android / Mac
   App 與中英雙語網站。

合作方式：AI 能見度健檢（3 天）、代理試作（2 週、固定報價、用真實資料跑）、
或按月的兼任工程夥伴。服務語言為中文（繁體）與英文；台灣的案子由夏裕科技股份有限公司承接並開立統一發票，美國的案子由 QY LLC 承接。
聯絡方式：yufan@shiptolive.com 或網站上的聯絡表單（不公開電話）。
中文網站：https://shiptolive.com/zh/
